recipe.basis: Official plan route and completed2025 photos; deck height/width, pier spacing are visual estimates

limitations: Individual floors except210/211 need as-built register confirmation; other heights are aerial silhouette estimates, not certified metrics.
Plan is2024 sales illustration, cross-checked against actual2025 photographs; exterior details on unseen faces are inferred.
Site mask is digitized and must be overlap-reviewed before suppressing surrounding original buildings.
Only the seven documented highway-facing towers use curtain-wall-look elevations; podiums and louver spacing are photo-led approximations.
